label: HEC-04 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene HEC-04 Hma-embedded candidate locus, encoding an ABC ATPase fused to a TOPRIM-family nuclease domain, that can reduce bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ABC ATPase or TOPRIM-family nuclease domains, the source database row naming one HEC-04 model, the DefenseFinder HEC-04 HMM profile row, unresolved HEC-04 effector chemistry, the absent DefenseFinder HEC-04 rules row, and other Hma-embedded candidate or phage-defense systems.
